mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_PASSWORD , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , U.USER_STATUS , U.USER_ENABLED , C.COM_NAME , C.COM_INFO , C.COM_NUM , C.COM_EMAIL , C.COM_URL , C.COM_CREATE_YEAR , C.COM_MEM , C.COM_LOGO , C.COM_PAYMENT , C.INDUSTRY_TYPE , C.COM_TYPE , C.COM_SIZE , C.INSURANCE_YN , C.CEO_NAME , C.COM_ADDR , C.COM_CAPITAL , C.COM_MAIN_BIZ FROM COMPANY C JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USER_PASSWORD , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_WITHDRAW_DATE , U.USER_STATUS , U.USER_ENABLED , C.COM_NAME , C.COM_INFO , C.COM_NUM , C.COM_EMAIL , C.COM_URL , C.COM_CREATE_YEAR , C.COM_MEM , C.COM_LOGO , C.COM_PAYMENT , C.INDUSTRY_TYPE , C.COM_TYPE , C.COM_SIZE , C.INSURANCE_YN , C.CEO_NAME , C.COM_ADDR , C.COM_CAPITAL , C.COM_MAIN_BIZ FROM COMPANY C JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID

SELECT USER_ID , COM_NAME , COM_INFO , COM_NUM , COM_EMAIL , COM_URL , COM_CREATE_YEAR , COM_MEM , COM_LOGO , COM_BACKGROUND_IMG , COM_PAYMENT , INDUSTRY_TYPE , COM_TYPE , COM_SIZE , INSURANCE_YN , CEO_NAME , COM_ADDR , COM_CAPITAL , COM_MAIN_BIZ FROM COMPANY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT C.USER_ID, C.COM_NAME, C.COM_INFO, C.COM_NUM, C.COM_EMAIL, C.COM_URL, C.COM_CREATE_YEAR, C.COM_MEM, C.COM_LOGO, C.COM_BACKGROUND_IMG, C.COM_PAYMENT, C.INDUSTRY_TYPE, C.COM_TYPE, C.COM_SIZE, C.INSURANCE_YN, C.CEO_NAME, C.COM_ADDR, C.COM_CAPITAL, C.COM_MAIN_BIZ FROM COMPANY C WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMPANY_REVIEW R WHERE R.COM_ID = C.USER_ID ) ORDER BY C.COM_NAME
